Dear Stijn,

I'm excited to apply for the Performance Marketeer role at Introw. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content, and analytics, I'm drawn to Introw's mission of transforming partnerships into revenue engines. Your focus on turning spend and signals into qualified pipeline resonates with my data-driven approach.

At Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, using tools like Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Google Ads to guide decisions. On my own project, mirook.com, I've implemented structured data and technical audits to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my ability to learn and apply new strategies quickly.

While my experience is more SEO-focused, I'm eager to expand into paid channels and ABM. I'm comfortable with analytics and reporting, and I'm a fast learner when it comes to new tools like Clay and Lemlist. I'm passionate about technology and marketing, and I'm ready to take ownership and build from scratch.

I'd love to discuss how I can contribute to Introw's growth. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Stijn,

I'm writing to express my enthusiasm for the Performance Marketeer position at Introw. As a junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, content, and web development, I'm excited about the opportunity to contribute to a platform that's redefining B2B partnerships.

Your job description emphasizes turning spend and signals into qualified pipeline, and that's exactly the kind of challenge I thrive on. At Episto, I've been responsible for on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and WordPress site builds, using data from Google Analytics, Search Console, SEMrush, and Google Ads to inform decisions. I've learned to focus on lead quality and conversion, not just vanity metrics.

What particularly excites me about Introw is the emphasis on partnerships and the innovative use of AI. I've always been passionate about technology and marketing, and I've demonstrated my ability to adapt and learn quickly. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This experience has given me a solid understanding of how to optimize for discoverability, which I believe is crucial for performance marketing.

While my direct experience is more SEO-focused, I'm eager to expand into paid channels like LinkedIn Ads and Google Ads, and to master tools like Clay and Lemlist. I'm a builder at heart—I take ownership, move fast, and enjoy creating things from scratch. I'm also comfortable with reporting and analytics, and I'm not afraid to dive into the numbers to find insights.

I'm based in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and I'm ready to bring my entrepreneurial spirit and data-driven mindset to Introw. I'd love the chance to discuss how I can help turn partnerships into powerful revenue engines.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Warm regards,

Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- Performance Marketing: Google Ads, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & Build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & Reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment
